records.jp: ヒナちゃん、ヒナちゃん

records.en_auxiliary: Hina, Hina!
records.en: Hina, Hina!

records.en_auxiliary: What is it? Did you find a clue to our next Fragment?
records.en: What is it? Did you find a clue to our next Fragment?

records.jp: ううん。実は今日、ユズたち用事があって帰らなきゃいけないの

records.en_auxiliary: No, I was just gonna say that Lime and I have to go home early today.
records.en: Er, sorry, I was just gonna say that Lime and I have to go home early today.

records.en_original: Which also means we can't hang out. Sorry.

records.en: Which also means we can't hang out. Sorry.

records.en_original: Oh... Well, okay, I'll see you tomorrow.

records.en: Oh... Well, okay, I'll see you tomorrow.

records.en: Bye-bye.

records.en: (I might as well go home, too.)

records.jp: 白井ちゃん！
records.en_original: Shirai!
records.en_auxiliary: Shirai!
records.en: Shirai!

records.jp: な、なに？
records.en_original: Wh-What?
records.en_auxiliary: Wh-what?
records.en: Wh-What?

records.jp: チャンスだよ！　二人の後をつけてみよう！
records.en_original: This is our chance! We've gotta tail 'em!
records.en_auxiliary: This is our chance! We've gotta tail 'em!
records.en: This is our chance! We've gotta tail 'em!

records.jp: ええっ、またー？　今日、散々調べたじゃん。<CR>もういいんじゃない？
records.en_original: Again with this? We've been spying on them all day. Haven't you had enough?
records.en_auxiliary: Again with this? We've been spying on them all day. Haven't you had enough?
records.en: Again with this? We've been spying on them all day. Haven't you had enough?

records.jp: けど、あの二人が放課後、何をしてるか気にならない？
records.en_original: Aw, come on! Aren't you curious what those two get up to after school?
records.en_auxiliary: But aren't you curious what those two are doing after school?
records.en: Aw, come on! Aren't you curious what those two get up to after school?

records.jp: それは、まあ……
records.en_original: Well, sort of...
records.en_auxiliary: Well, sort of...
records.en: Well, sort of...

records.jp: これで最後だから！　ね？
records.en_original: This is the last time, I promise! What do you say?
records.en_auxiliary: This is the last time, I promise! What do you say?
records.en: This is the last time, I promise! What do you say?

records.jp: はぁ。わかったよ……
records.en_original: *sigh* Fine...
records.en_auxiliary: *Sigh* Fine...
records.en: *sigh* Fine...

records.en_original: (It feels like we're the ones being watched...)
records.en_auxiliary: (It feels like we're the ones being watched...)
records.en: (It feels like we're the ones being watched...)

records.jp: 校門を出た！　ほら、行くよ白井ちゃん！
records.en_original: They're past the front gate! Onward, Shirai!
records.en_auxiliary: They're past the front gate! Let's go, Shirai!
records.en: They're past the front gate! Onward, Shirai!

records.jp: う、うん
records.en_original: I-I guess...
records.en_auxiliary: Y-yeah...
records.en: I-I guess...

records.en_original: Urk...
records.en_auxiliary: Urk...
records.en: Urk...

records.en_original: (What's with that expensive-looking car...?)
records.en_auxiliary: (What's with that expensive-looking car...?)
records.en: (What's with that expensive-looking car...?)

records.en_original: Where do you think you're going? It's dangerous to just wander about after school.
records.en_auxiliary: Where do you think you're going? Our house is in the other direction.
records.en: Where do you think you're going? It's dangerous to just wander about after school.

records.en_auxiliary: ...I'm sorry.
records.en: ...I'm sorry.

records.en_auxiliary: (How does Ichinose know this guy?)
records.en: (How does Ichinose know this guy?)

records.en_auxiliary: Sorry, Shirai. I've gotta go.
records.en: Sorry, Shirai I've gotta go.

records.jp: う、うん。わかった

records.en_auxiliary: S-sure. No worries.
records.en: S-Sure. No worries.

records.en_original: Sorry for dragging you into this. See ya.

records.en: Sorry for dragging you into this. See ya.

records.jp: うん。また明日

records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. See you tomorrow.
records.en: Yeah. See you tomorrow.

records.jp: 何だったんだろう……
records.en_original: What was that all about...?
records.en_auxiliary: What was that all about...?
records.en: What was that all about...?

records.jp: あれは少しまずいかも
records.en_original: That didn't look too good.
records.en_auxiliary: That didn't look too good.
records.en: That didn't look too good.

records.jp: うん、ちょっとよくないね

records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, something's off.
records.en: Yeah, something's off.

records.en_auxiliary: GAAAAAAH!
records.en: GAAAAAAH!

records.en: That's my line! How long have you been there?

records.jp: さあ、いつからでしょう？　ふふふ
records.en_original: I dunno, how long do you think? Heh heh heh...
records.en_auxiliary: I dunno, how long do you think? Heh heh heh...
records.en: I dunno, how long do you think? Heh heh heh...

records.en_auxiliary: You and Akky were following us all day today, weren't you?
records.en: You and Akky were following us all day today, weren't you?

records.en_auxiliary: Uh, yeah. You weren't exactly subtle.

records.en_original: Gah! Y-You're not going to mess with Ichinose's memories or anything, are you? To stop her from prying any further?
records.en_auxiliary: Gah! Y-you're not going to mess with Ichinose's memories or anything, are you? To stop her from prying any further?
